caption: The drawing depicts a small mechanical object resembling a bird mounted on a clamp. The object is positioned centrally on the otherwise plain, off-white background. The bird has metallic, brownish-gray wings extended outward and uses a red disk as its body, with an additional round red element on top that appears to be its head. There are visible metallic screws and bolts in the construction of the wings and clamp. The clamp itself is rendered in shades of brown and gray, with a screw mechanism at the bottom for attaching to a surface. The details are precise, with shading and highlights indicating the metallic and textured nature of the materials used in the object. The drawing has a minimal composition, with the object isolated in the center of the paper and no other items or distracting background elements present.
title: Sewing Bird
